result.instructions: Tools for Vinsight, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which sales orders are still open, and for which customers?"; "Find the stock item for our 2024 Shiraz and show its price list."; "Create a sales order for 2 cases of stock item 117 for contact 42.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vinsight data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vinsight_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vinsight_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vinsight_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. vinsight_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vinsight_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List the Vinsight API resources (endpoints) this token can reach, with their key names. Start here to find a resource name. Vinsight API: GET /Metadata.json.

skip.description: Records to skip (OData $skip). Use with $top to page.

tools.name: vinsight_describe_resource
tools.title: Describe a resource
tools.description: Get one resource's fields (type, nullable, read-only), navigation properties, writable child collections and custom actions. Use it before a create. Vinsight API: GET /Metadata/{Resource}.json?$expand=Metadata.

resource.description: Resource name, for example Contacts, StockItems or SalesOrders.

tools.name: vinsight_list_records
tools.title: List records of any resource
tools.description: List records of any Vinsight resource with OData $filter, $select, $orderby, $skip and $top. Use vinsight_list_resources to find the name. Vinsight API: GET /{Resource}.json.

resource.description: Resource name, for example Contacts, StockItems or SalesOrders.

filter.description: OData $filter, for example contains(LegalName,'Ciao') or Status eq 'OPEN' or InvoiceDate gt datetime'2026-01-01'.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return (OData $select). Keep it short.

skip.description: Records to skip (OData $skip). Use with $top to page.

tools.name: vinsight_get_record
tools.title: Get one record
tools.description: Get one record of any Vinsight resource by its key, with optional $select. Numeric keys such as 8821 work; string keys are encoded for you. Vinsight API: GET /{Resource}/{key}.json.

resource.description: Resource name, for example Contacts, StockItems or SalesOrders.

key.description: The record key, for example 8821 or a vessel code.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return (OData $select). Keep it short.

tools.name: vinsight_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List customers and suppliers (Contacts) with filter, order and paging. Default fields: ContactNum, LegalName, IsActive. Vinsight API: GET /Contacts.json.

filter.description: OData $filter, for example contains(LegalName,'Ciao') or Status eq 'OPEN' or InvoiceDate gt datetime'2026-01-01'.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return (OData $select). Keep it short.

skip.description: Records to skip (OData $skip). Use with $top to page.

tools.name: vinsight_list_stock_items
tools.title: List stock items
tools.description: List stock items (products and SKUs) with filter, order and paging. Default fields: StockItemNum, StockItemCode, Description, BaseUOM. Vinsight API: GET /StockItems.json.

filter.description: OData $filter, for example contains(LegalName,'Ciao') or Status eq 'OPEN' or InvoiceDate gt datetime'2026-01-01'.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return (OData $select). Keep it short.

skip.description: Records to skip (OData $skip). Use with $top to page.

tools.name: vinsight_list_sales_orders
tools.title: List sales orders
tools.description: List sales orders with filter, order and paging. Default fields: SalesOrderNum, Status, InvoiceDate, ContactNum. Vinsight API: GET /SalesOrders.json.

filter.description: OData $filter, for example contains(LegalName,'Ciao') or Status eq 'OPEN' or InvoiceDate gt datetime'2026-01-01'.

select.description: Comma-separated fields to return (OData $select). Keep it short.

skip.description: Records to skip (OData $skip). Use with $top to page.

tools.name: vinsight_create_sales_order
tools.title: Create a sales order
tools.description: Create a sales order for a contact, with optional line items. This writes a new numbered order that uses the next number in the sequence; it does not email anyone. Required: ContactNum, DivisionNum, CurrencyNum, InvoiceDate. Vinsight API: POST /SalesOrders.json.

DivisionNum.description: Division number from your Vinsight set-up (check with vinsight_describe_resource on SalesOrders).

Quantity.description: Quantity in the unit of measure.

UnitOfMeasureCode.description: Unit of measure code, for example CASE.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Vinsight
prompts.description: What you can do with Vinsight here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: check_which_sales_orders_are_still_open
prompts.title: Check which sales orders are still open
prompts.description: List the sales orders with their status, invoice date and contact number. Then list the contacts to find the customer behind each open order.

prompts.name: find_a_stock_item_by_code_or_description
prompts.title: Find a stock item by code or description
prompts.description: Search the stock items by code or description. Then read one item by its key to see the fields you need.

prompts.name: explore_any_vinsight_resource_with_filters
prompts.title: Explore any Vinsight resource with filters
prompts.description: List the resources this token can reach and describe one of them. Then list its records with filters, sort order and paging.

prompts.name: review_the_order_history_of_one_customer
prompts.title: Review the order history of one customer
prompts.description: Find the customer in the contact list. Then list the sales orders for that contact number, with their status and invoice date.

prompts.name: create_a_sales_order_for_a_contact
prompts.title: Create a sales order for a contact
prompts.description: Look up the contact and the stock item, then create the sales order. The order takes the next number in the sequence, and no email goes to the customer.
